newsitem.title: FINLAND: SUUNTO 96 PRE-TAX PROFIT FIM 12-14 MLN.
newsitem.headline: SUUNTO 96 PRE-TAX PROFIT FIM 12-14 MLN.

text.p: Finnish compass maker Suunto Oy said on Friday its third tertial sales had been weaker than expected and extra costs also meant its full-year 1996 pre-tax profit would be between 12 to 14 million markka.
"This due to the fact that there was less demand for diving equipment and electronics than expected," Suunto said in a statement refferring to the fall in net sales.
Suunto said that it also booked substantial marketing and product development costs at end-year 1996.
The full-year 1996 net sales will be around 282 million markka, on par with 1995, it said.
